title: Merit Based International Scholarships
field: Engineering, architecture and design (English-taught Master's programmes)
about: Politecnico di Milano's Merit Based International Scholarships for academic year 2027-2028 are awarded to applicants to its English-taught Master's programmes. All awards include a tuition fee waiver; the scholarship form is submitted through Politecnico di Milano Online Services by 15 December 2026.
requirements: Applicants to Politecnico di Milano Master of Science programmes taught in English
Admission application fee paid between 1 October and 1 December 2026
Valid English certificate submitted by 4 March 2027 to be considered

upskill.name: the course catalog
why: Shortlist matches were generic words only ("design", "architecture", "engineer" in AI-system objectives), not a genuine match for English-taught Master's programmes in engineering, architecture and design; fallback to the Academy catalog.
